# Atulya Bharat Run

> Virtual running, walking, and cycling challenges across India. Cover real distances and unlock cultural milestones from iconic Indian cities, join clubs, and earn rewards.

Atulya Bharat Run is a virtual fitness platform for runners, walkers, and cyclists in India. Users register for distance-based challenges themed around Indian heritage cities, track activity via Strava or manual entry, and join or create running clubs.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of featured virtual challenges, clubs, and how the platform works.
- [Challenges](/challenges): Browse all active virtual running and cycling challenges across India.
- [Clubs](/clubs): Directory of registered running and fitness clubs.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on running tips, event recaps, club stories, and fitness guides.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Top participants across active challenges.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos from challenges, events, and community meetups.
- [About](/about): About Atulya Bharat Run — mission and team.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the Atulya Bharat Run team.
